scientific_question: Can sign-preserving local residual phase, and then a permutation-equivariant geometry-aligned cross-camera residual phase, repair every remaining v136 observation-only failure while preserving the same 2A+2A^T shell?

advisor_alignment.direction: Build and validate on virtual reaction-flow CFD first; migrate to a new laboratory experimental set when it becomes available.
advisor_alignment.current_inputs: Every active camera carries an 18-value reported pose token and each forward/adjoint operator is rebuilt from the corresponding reported geometry.
advisor_alignment.current_stress: The frozen v128 roster contains clean, observation-noise, extrinsic pose, intrinsic calibration and combined perturbations, evaluated with 5, 7, 9 and 12 active cameras.
advisor_alignment.next_required_stress: After this representation gate, separately freeze arbitrary camera add/drop, camera-order permutation, focal/principal-point and extrinsic perturbation tests. Nested camera counts in this diagnostic do not by themselves prove arbitrary camera-set generalization.
advisor_alignment.future_real_data: Keep the clean CFD baseline and use future laboratory displacement images, calibration files and repeated measurements only for a separately frozen migration and final validation gate.

prior_result.interpretation: The residual-energy-adaptive windows rescued 53 additional cells and preserved all field and gradient gates, but 485 observation-only failures remained. Squared energy discards residual sign and phase, and the v136 windows do not use cross-camera pose coupling; v137 changes exactly those two representation ingredients.

data_contract.role: post-open fit-only signed-phase and cross-camera representation capacity diagnostic
data_contract.factorized_conditions: The frozen v128 roster of 37 clean, observation-noise, pose, intrinsic and combined conditions.

representation_contract.parent_basis: Exactly the complete v136 residual-energy-adaptive basis, retained as the first 32 directions per active camera.
representation_contract.visible_adaptation_input: The active-camera zero-start CGLS K1 detector residual and each active camera's 18-value reported pose token.
representation_contract.self_signed_phase: For each camera and displacement component, phase=tanh(residual/RMS(residual)); maps with RMS at most 1e-30 use phase zero. This is bounded, odd under sign reversal and invariant to positive residual scale.
representation_contract.reported_frame_axes: Pose-token entries 3:6 and 6:9 are the reported right/up axes; entries 0:3 are the reported optical direction. Every frame must be right-handed and orthonormal within 2e-12.
representation_contract.geometry_aligned_peer_residual: Lift every peer camera's two residual components into the common world frame with its reported right/up axes; average all other active cameras at each normalized 16x16 detector coordinate; project the average back onto the target camera's reported right/up axes.
representation_contract.peer_signed_phase: Apply the identical tanh/RMS phase rule to the geometry-aligned peer residual.
representation_contract.new_directions: Multiply each v133 per-camera/component LL/LH/HL/HH direction first by its own signed phase map and then by its peer signed phase map.
representation_contract.direction_order: All v136 parent directions, then all self-phase-modulated v133 directions, then all peer-phase-modulated v133 directions.
representation_contract.nested_basis_counts: The self-only basis has 40 directions per camera (v136 32 plus self 8); the full basis has 48 per camera (plus peer 8), hence full counts 240/336/432/576 for 5/7/9/12 cameras.
representation_contract.strict_containment: The first 32 directions per camera are exactly v136; setting every new phase coefficient to zero reproduces any v136 candidate.
representation_contract.variable_cardinality: All means use only active cameras and normalize by active peer count.
representation_contract.camera_permutation_equivariance: The self rule is shared and the peer world-frame average is symmetric; permuting active cameras permutes output basis blocks without changing their values.
representation_contract.detector_coordinate_limit: Cross-view averaging assumes a common normalized 16x16 detector-coordinate proxy. It is a representation diagnostic, not an exact epipolar or tomographic warp.
representation_contract.input_proposal: The independently validated v131.1 held-out predicted correction dual restricted to active cameras.
representation_contract.deployment_boundary: Both phase maps are deployment-visible. Truth-aware coefficient fitting and final candidate selection remain opened-fit capacity diagnostics, not deployable estimators.

staged_evaluation.cheap_control_scope: Run the deployment-visible full signed-phase 24-direction per-camera/component joint-LS control on all 3700 cells.
staged_evaluation.parent_retention: Retain the independently validated v136 candidate and metrics for the 3215 cells already passing all four per-cell gates.
staged_evaluation.oracle_scope: Run the two nested seven-candidate truth-aware rosters only on the frozen 485 v136 failure indices.
staged_evaluation.ablation_readout: Report how many of the 485 failures have any passing self-only arm, and how many additional failures are rescued only after peer-phase directions are admitted.
staged_evaluation.scientific_boundary: The final selected result is a truth-aware nested-span capacity upper bound. It does not establish a deployable coefficient predictor.

objective_roster.finite_weight_objective: Separately in the self-only and full nested bases, minimize unit-weight relative squared teacher field-lift error plus projection_weight times relative squared teacher projected-lift error.
objective_roster.projection_only_objective: Minimize relative squared teacher projected-lift error with zero field weight.
objective_roster.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of each candidate unregularized weighted Gram matrix.
objective_roster.formal_solver: float64 direct solve of the regularized normal equations
objective_roster.independent_solver: float64 symmetric eigendecomposition of the same frozen equations
objective_roster.canonicalization: Normalize active coefficients to unit RMS and orient the common sign toward nonnegative projected-target inner product.
objective_roster.selector: Prefer any all-four-metric feasible candidate by minimum worst ratio, then observation ratio and roster order; otherwise minimize observation among three-physical-metric feasible candidates; otherwise use physical minimax.
objective_roster.truth_boundary: Teacher targets, final metric ratios and the selector use already-opened fit truth only to test capacity.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible signed-phase per-camera/component joint least squares
cheap_control.definition: For each active camera and displacement component, jointly fit its 16 v136 directions, four self-phase directions and four peer-phase directions to the visible K1 residual with a fixed ridge; concatenate, normalize to unit RMS and use the unchanged observable line search.
cheap_control.purpose: Test whether the deterministic deployment-visible phase representation alone explains any capacity gain.

accuracy_gate.grouping: Each complete trajectory separately over all 740 cells.
accuracy_gate.truth_aware_cell_pass_requirement: All four metric ratios must be at most 1.05 for every one of the 3700 opened cells.

call_accounting.candidate_online_shell: zero-start CGLS K1 plus one selected exact A_g^T lift and one exact A_g projection
call_accounting.phase_generation_cost: Per-camera RMS/tanh, reported-axis component lifts/projections and one symmetric peer mean; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.cheap_control_coefficient_cost: Detector-space 24x24 group solves only; no exact operator call.
call_accounting.offline_capacity_work: Truth-aware basis batching, fourteen solves and candidate evaluation are diagnostic-only and excluded from deployable cost claims.
call_accounting.parent_retention_boundary: Inherited v136 cells retain their already validated 2A+2A^T shell.

decision_rule.cheap_control_pass_action: If the cheap control alone passes 3700/3700 and all five trajectories, attribute the result to the deterministic control and do not claim learned advantage.
decision_rule.self_only_pass_action: If the self-only nested oracle passes all cells and tails, conclude that local signed phase is sufficient on this opened proxy and do not attribute necessity to cross-camera coupling.
decision_rule.peer_incremental_action: If full passes but self-only does not, record that the geometry-aligned peer phase supplies necessary development-set span headroom under this finite roster.
decision_rule.oracle_pass_action: If the parent-retention oracle passes 3700/3700 and all five trajectories while the cheap control fails, authorize only one separately frozen minimal permutation-equivariant observation/geometry-only coefficient predictor under complete-trajectory LOTO.
decision_rule.oracle_fail_action: Close this exact tanh/RMS signed-phase plus normalized-detector peer-average representation. Do not enlarge CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet; inspect a physically distinct residual mechanism.
decision_rule.inference_limit: Failure does not prove continuous adaptive-span impossibility, and success does not prove coefficient predictability, arbitrary camera-set generalization, speed, external generalization or real-BOST validity.

source_contract.truth_gauge: interior mean removed with a zero boundary support mask
